text.hi: आज की कहानी: ‘The Mango Tree’ (आम का पेड़)। पहले कुछ शब्द सीखते हैं।
text.hinglish: Aaj ki kahani: ‘The Mango Tree’ (Aam ka ped). Pehle kuch shabd seekhte hain.
text.en: Today's story: ‘The Mango Tree’. First, a few words.

text.hi: ‘mango’ मतलब आम। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘mango’ matlab aam. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘mango’ means आम. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘summer’ मतलब गर्मी का मौसम। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘summer’ matlab garmi ka mausam. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘summer’ means गर्मी का मौसम. Tap to listen, then say it.

text.hi: ‘neighbours’ मतलब पड़ोसी। छूकर सुनो, फिर बोलो।
text.hinglish: ‘neighbours’ matlab padosi. Chhookar suno, phir bolo.
text.en: ‘neighbours’ means पड़ोसी. Tap to listen, then say it.

sentences: There is a big mango tree near my house.
In summer it is full of mangoes.
My brother and I wait under the tree.
When a mango falls, we run to get it.
The mangoes are sweet and yellow.
Sometimes a monkey comes to the tree, because he also likes mangoes!
We share the mangoes with our neighbours.

question.en: When is the tree full of mangoes?

question.hi: पेड़ पर कभी-कभी कौन आता है?
question.hinglish: Ped par kabhi-kabhi kaun aata hai?
question.en: Who sometimes comes to the tree?
